notes.title: 2024/2/3 Server Merge Notice
notes.content:
Dear players,
The following servers have been merged: S6-S10.
After the server merge, you will still be able to choose the original server and log in with your characters on the game login interface.
Rules:
1. Under the same account, characters can still be selected through the server, and all character data will be retained. For example, if account A has 4 characters on S6 and S10 servers respectively, after the merge, you can still access these characters through the original S6 and S10.
2. In-game rankings will be recalculated.
3. In the event of duplicated character names after the merge, the names of players with the same name will have their respective server names added.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience

notes.title: 2023/12/22 Live Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear heroes,
We have noticed the unfavorable events occurring in the world of Little Shrimp and have taken corrective measures to address the related issues. Please trust that the Little Shrimp team is always attentive to every detail, every individual, and is dedicated to presenting the most wonderful world of Little Shrimp for everyone.

2. Adjusted the location of the button in the cave.
3. In the cave, clicking on capture missions or celestial book missions will prompt to exit the cave for navigation.
4. Removed tasks that automatically reach the daily experience limit during AFK mode
5. If the number of task objectives is over 1, the middle task bar now displays task progress.
6. Fixed an issue where task prompt messages for reaching levels 20, 25, 30, etc., would incorrectly indicate navigation difficulties.

notes.title: Super-value recharge rebate welfare activities, with extremely generous rewards
notes.content:
Fellow heroes, please don't miss out!
To celebrate the smooth launch, [b]we have introduced various super-value recharge welfare activities to help you[/b], brave heroes, forge ahead in the world of Little Shrimp and become peak characters!

[h2]The events is divided into three types. [/h2]
The first is the permanent recharge rebate event, which will continue as long as Little Shrimp exists. The second is [h3]the limited-time recharge rebate event, open from now until November 19, 2023, 23:59 (UTC+8)[/h3]. This is a rare opportunity, so don't miss it! 
Details of the event can be found in the image below 
[h2]Permanent Recharge Rebate Event:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694397/c23e40f77dcf5fa5be37e3defbb9f1950ac39780.jpg[/img]
[h2]Limited-Time Recharge Rebate Event:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694397/062ada59b678dbf7b879aafb4e0a3f931be5f084.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694397/4a977d53af591c330b55f644c697ec001acefe8d.jpg[/img]

The third type is the exclusive welfare event for special members. Fellow heroes who have already joined the Little Shrimp Discord community can learn more in the #GAME-REBATE channel.

[h3]Joining Discord also comes with exclusive gift codes[/h3], and there are various gift codes waiting for you to redeem in the Discord community.
[b] 🔗Discord: https://discord.gg/PzYXyYjBCJ [/b]
